properties.name: CAD object id
properties.definition: CAD object identifier from the source document

properties.name: Label
properties.definition: Human-readable label from the CAD tree

properties.name: CAD type id
properties.definition: CAD type id (e.g. Part::Feature)

properties.name: Units
properties.definition: Units the geometry was measured in

properties.name: Volume
properties.definition: Solid volume

properties.name: Area
properties.definition: Total surface area

properties.name: Envelope
properties.definition: Bounding box dimensions sorted largest-first (orientation independent)

properties.name: Envelope A
properties.definition: Largest sorted bounding-box dimension

properties.name: Envelope B
properties.definition: Middle sorted bounding-box dimension

properties.name: Envelope C
properties.definition: Smallest sorted bounding-box dimension

properties.name: Bounding box
properties.definition: Axis-aligned bounding box (xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax,zmin,zmax), part coordinates

properties.name: Centre of mass
properties.definition: Centre of mass, part coordinates

properties.name: Principal moments
properties.definition: Principal moments of the area (rotation invariant, mass-free)

properties.name: Radii of gyration
properties.definition: Principal radii of gyration

properties.name: Solid count
properties.definition: Number of solids

properties.name: Shell count
properties.definition: Number of shells

properties.name: Face count
properties.definition: Number of faces

properties.name: Edge count
properties.definition: Number of edges

properties.name: Vertex count
properties.definition: Number of vertices

properties.name: Surface histogram
properties.definition: Surface-type histogram (Plane/Cylinder/Cone/Sphere/Toroid/BSplineSurface/...)

properties.name: Curve histogram
properties.definition: Curve-type histogram (Line/Circle/...)

properties.name: Features
properties.definition: Marker: this key's list becomes this part's feature entities (see feat.*)

properties.name: Shape ratios
properties.definition: Scale-free shape descriptors (aspect_1, aspect_2, fill, compactness)

properties.name: Build parameters
properties.definition: Named build parameters

properties.name: Material
properties.definition: Material name

properties.name: Volume method
properties.definition: formula|mesh agreement method for volume, union over solids

properties.name: Volume uncertainty
properties.definition: Volume uncertainty estimate for the mesh path

properties.name: Area method
properties.definition: formula|mesh agreement method for area, union over solids

properties.name: Area uncertainty
properties.definition: Area uncertainty estimate for the mesh path

properties.name: Family
properties.definition: Classifier family (framework/catalog/families.json)

properties.name: Family reason
properties.definition: Reason the classifier assigned this family

properties.name: Feature kind
properties.definition: cylinder | plane | cone | sphere | torus

properties.name: Feature role
properties.definition: bore | od | face | chamfer | countersink | ...

properties.name: Diameter
properties.definition: Cylinder/sphere/torus diameter

properties.name: Semi-angle
properties.definition: Cone semi-angle, true signed value paired with feat.axis

properties.name: Semi-angle (legacy)
properties.definition: Legacy abs(semi_angle_deg), kept for parity with older unsigned records

properties.name: Axis
properties.definition: Sign-normalised true axis (first non-zero component positive)

properties.name: Axis (legacy)
properties.definition: Legacy abs-per-component axis, kept for parity with older unsigned records

properties.name: Position
properties.definition: Point on the axis, or on the plane

properties.name: Offset
properties.definition: Plane: signed distance from origin to plane along the normal

properties.name: Length
properties.definition: Cylinder: length along axis; plane: sqrt(area)

properties.name: Interface kind
properties.definition: cylindrical_fit | planar_contact

properties.name: Nominal A
properties.definition: Nominal size of the OD/first-face side

properties.name: Nominal B
properties.definition: Nominal size of the bore/second-face side

properties.name: Clearance
properties.definition: Bore minus shaft; planar: gap

properties.name: Fit class
properties.definition: clearance | transition | interference

properties.name: Quantity
properties.definition: Source BOM row quantity; migration expands this into N occurrence rows, this property records the original qty for audit

properties.name: Mass
properties.definition: Volume x density. With the default material the density is assumed (steel) and the fact says so: confidence 0.5, measure_method 'default density'

properties.name: Density
properties.definition: Density used for part.mass, from framework/catalog/materials.json by the part's material

properties.name: Exact extent
properties.definition: The part's exact extent along x, y, z (xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax,zmin,zmax), measured on its exact shape with no tolerance and no control-point hull (the stored part.bbox is the quick box)

properties.name: Exact size
properties.definition: part.tight_bbox's three sizes sorted largest first (orientation independent)

properties.name: Length (exact)
properties.definition: Largest exact size

properties.name: Width (exact)
properties.definition: Middle exact size

properties.name: Thickness / height (exact)
properties.definition: Smallest exact size

properties.name: Connection features
properties.definition: How the part connects, from its measured features: bores, outside diameters, hole patterns, keyways, flats, threads (framework/catalog/pg/partrecord.py)

properties.name: Family parameters
properties.definition: The values of the parameters its family has (class_property rows with required = true)

properties.name: Bores
properties.definition: Bores (holes) of the part: separate bore axes, the part card's grouping

properties.name: Largest bore
properties.definition: Largest bore diameter

properties.name: Smallest bore
properties.definition: Smallest bore diameter

properties.name: Largest outside diameter
properties.definition: Largest outside diameter, blends left out

properties.name: Smallest outside diameter
properties.definition: Smallest outside diameter, blends left out

properties.name: Diameter steps
properties.definition: Distinct outside diameters (0.01 mm), blends left out

properties.name: Hole patterns
properties.definition: Groups of 2 or more equal bores on parallel, separate axes, on a circle or in a row

properties.name: Keyways
properties.definition: Keyways: two parallel faces facing each other across a cylinder's axis, narrower than its diameter

properties.name: Flats
properties.definition: Flats: a face parallel to a cylinder's axis that cuts into it
